Title: D6: Two-Machine Deployment Topology
Content: Decision D6 (locked, 2026-06-01): Two-machine deployment. Machine A = local laptop running the coding agent: Orchestrator.Mcp (port 5100), SplitBrain.Dashboard, and optionally the Copilot node (Node C). Machine B = secondary inference tower: Orchestrator.NodeWorker (port 5050) + Ollama or llama.cpp server. Dashboard and MCP can merge into a single host on Machine A. NodeWorker stays as a separate deployable for Machine B. This topology enables offloading heavy inference (30B MoE models) to a dedicated GPU machine without network latency on the MCP path.
